nodes.name: processor.ts
nodes.summary: SessionProcessor service that drives the per-stream LLM event loop: consumes LLM stream events, materializes text/reasoning/tool parts onto messages, tracks file snapshots, enforces doom-loop protection, wires the retry policy, and flags context overflow for compaction. Also dual-writes V2 SessionEvent projections behind the OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_EVENT_SYSTEM flag.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect service built with Effect.fn closures inside Layer.effect; the Service class is a one-line Context.Service tag (@opencode/SessionProcessor) and all behavior lives in the create() factory returning a Handle interface.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Factory that builds the per-assistant-message processing Handle: pre-captures a snapshot, wires tool-call lifecycle helpers (settle/read/update/complete/fail), the stream event reducer, cleanup, halt, and the process() stream runner.

nodes.name: handleEvent
nodes.summary: Reducer over LLM stream events: maps start/step/text/reasoning/tool events onto message parts, computes usage via Session.getUsage, emits patch parts from snapshot diffs, kicks off summary, triggers the doom-loop permission ask after 3 identical tool calls, and sets overflow-driven compaction.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: Runs the LLM stream with tap-event handling, takeUntil compaction cutoff, interrupt handling, the SessionRetry policy (publishing retry status and SessionEvent.Retried), catch-to-halt, and guaranteed cleanup; returns compact/stop/continue.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Finalizer that flushes leftover snapshot patches, closes open text/reasoning parts, waits briefly on in-flight tool calls, and marks any still-running tool parts as aborted with an interrupted metadata flag.

nodes.name: projectors-next.ts
nodes.summary: V2 event projectors that fold SessionEvent.* sync events (prompted, step, text, tool, reasoning, compaction, retries) into the SessionMessageTable read model via SessionMessageUpdater and a SQLite adapter; delta events are deliberately no-ops.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports a default array of SyncEvent.project handlers spread into projectors.ts; DateTime values are recursively encoded to epoch millis before JSON persistence.

nodes.name: sqlite
nodes.summary: Builds the SessionMessageUpdater SQLite adapter for a session: queries current assistant/compaction/shell messages from SessionMessageTable and implements append plus typed update operations that re-encode message data.

nodes.name: projectors.ts
nodes.summary: V1 projector registry: SyncEvent.project handlers that materialize Session and MessageV2 events into the SessionTable/MessageTable/PartTable Drizzle tables, tolerating late foreign-key-violating updates, and re-exports the V2 projectors-next array.

nodes.name: grab
nodes.summary: Reads a (possibly nested) field from a partial update object, applying a callback for object values; throws when a present-but-undefined field is passed so callers must use null to clear a column.

nodes.name: toPartialRow
nodes.summary: Maps a DeepPartial Session.Info patch onto a snake_case partial SessionTable row, unwrapping nested share/summary/time objects via grab and dropping undefined keys so Drizzle updates only touched columns.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: SessionPrompt service exposing prompt/loop/shell/command/predict/cancel entry points; it wires twenty-plus Effect services into the agent run loop, resolves file and agent template parts, merges per-prompt tool permissions, and defines the PromptInput/LoopInput/ShellInput/CommandInput API schemas.
nodes.languageNotes: Composition root for the session loop: runLoop/shellImpl/command/predict implementations are injected from ./loop/* modules as plain function calls, and the layer's defaultLayer chains 20+ provided layers.

nodes.name: resolvePromptParts
nodes.summary: Expands @-mention markdown templates into prompt parts: resolves each ConfigMarkdown file reference against the worktree (or home dir), attaching file parts or agent parts when the name matches an agent instead of a file.

nodes.name: prompt
nodes.summary: Handles a user prompt: cleans up pending reverts, creates the user message (with attachments/skills), merges per-prompt tool toggles into session permissions, then enters the loop unless noReply is set.

nodes.name: loop
nodes.summary: Runs the agent loop for a session through SessionRunState.ensureRunning, injecting the full service bundle (sessions, processor, compaction, registry, MCP, LSP, permission, truncation, runner bridge, cached tool schemas) into runLoop.

nodes.name: command-regex.ts
nodes.summary: Regex constants for the slash-command parser: inline bash extraction (!`cmd`), argument tokenization (including [Image N] and quoted strings), positional placeholders, and quote trimming.

nodes.name: mcp-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: Derives permission-scoping patterns from MCP tool arguments by probing common path/URL fields, so an "always allow" grant covers a specific resource instead of every invocation; falls back to the "*" wildcard.

nodes.name: deriveMcpPatterns
nodes.summary: Returns the first non-empty string among well-known path/URL argument keys (filepath, path, url, directory, file, pattern, repo, repository) as a single-element pattern array, or ["*"] when nothing can be derived.

nodes.name: predict.ts
nodes.summary: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction: system/nudge prompts for the predictor model plus cleanPrediction, which strips think blocks, quotes, and caps output to 120 chars for the TUI's gray inline suggestion.

nodes.name: cleanPrediction
nodes.summary: Cleans raw predict LLM output: removes <think> blocks, takes the first non-empty trimmed line, strips surrounding quotes/backticks, and truncates to 120 characters with an ellipsis.

nodes.name: structured-output.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the AI SDK StructuredOutput tool used when a zod output schema is requested: forces the model to emit its final answer through one validated tool call and captures the parsed result via an onSuccess callback.

nodes.name: createStructuredOutputTool
nodes.summary: Creates the StructuredOutput AI SDK tool from a JSON schema (dropping $schema), invoking onSuccess with SDK-validated args and echoing a text model output so the loop terminates cleanly after capture.

nodes.name: retry.ts
nodes.summary: Retry policy for provider calls: retryable() classifies API errors (5xx, rate limits, OpenCode Go/free-tier limit bodies), delay() honors retry-after headers before falling back to exponential backoff, and policy() wraps both into an Effect Schedule that reports status updates.

nodes.name: delay
nodes.summary: Computes the retry wait: prefers retry-after-ms and retry-after headers (numeric seconds or HTTP date), otherwise exponential backoff (2s base, factor 2) capped at 30s without headers or the 32-bit setTimeout maximum with them.

nodes.name: retryable
nodes.summary: Classifies an error into a Retryable verdict: never retries context overflow, retries 5xx and SDK-marked retryable API errors, maps FreeUsageLimit/GoUsageLimit bodies to upsell actions with reset-time hints, and string-matches plain-text and JSON rate-limit payloads.

nodes.name: policy
nodes.summary: Builds the Effect retry Schedule from retryable/delay: parses each failure, stops the schedule on non-retryable errors, and reports attempt, message, optional upsell action, and next-attempt time through the caller's set callback.

nodes.name: revert.ts
nodes.summary: SessionRevert service implementing checkpoint/restore over message parts and file snapshots: revert() rewinds to a message/part boundary recording the pre-revert snapshot, unrevert() restores it, and cleanup() deletes the post-revert tail before a new prompt runs.

nodes.name: revert
nodes.summary: Walks the session's messages to locate the revert boundary, captures or reuses the pre-revert snapshot, undoes accumulated patches, recomputes the diff summary, and persists the revert metadata plus refreshed session diff on the session row.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes messages and trailing parts created after a revert point (emitting MessageV2 Removed/PartRemoved sync events) and clears the revert marker so subsequent prompts start from a consistent history.

nodes.name: run-state.ts
nodes.summary: SessionRunState service tracking one Runner per session in instance state: enforces busy/idle transitions (publishing status events), rejects concurrent prompts with BusyError, cancels in-flight runs, and hosts ensureRunning/startShell execution modes.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Lazily creates (or returns the existing) per-session Runner wired to idle/busy status publishing, the interrupt handler for the current assistant message, and a BusyError throw on concurrent use.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Branded Effect Schema identifiers for the session domain: SessionID (descending ULID-like ids), MessageID and PartID (ascending), each with static make helpers for ordered generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Schema.String.check(Schema.isStartsWith(...)).pipe(Schema.brand(...)) plus withStatics to attach ascending/descending generators to the schema object.

nodes.name: session.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle SQLite schema for the session domain: session, message, part, todo, session_message (V2 read model), and permission tables with cascading foreign keys, JSON-typed payload columns, and covering indexes for the common query paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the repo's snake_case column convention so column names never need string overrides; composite payloads (revert, permission, model, diffs) are stored as text JSON via text({ mode: "json" }).$type<T>().

nodes.name: session
nodes.summary: Core session table: SessionID primary key, project FK with cascade delete, workspace/parent self-reference, slug/directory/path/title/version, share URL, aggregate diff summary columns, JSON revert/permission/model payloads, and compacting/archived timestamps; indexed by project, workspace, and parent.

nodes.name: message
nodes.summary: Message table storing one row per MessageV2 message with a JSON data payload minus id/sessionID, cascading from session, and a composite (session_id, time_created, id) index for paged history reads.

nodes.name: part
nodes.summary: Message part table (text, reasoning, tool, step, patch parts) keyed by PartID with a message FK cascade, denormalized session_id, JSON part payload, and (message_id, id) plus session indexes.

nodes.name: todo
nodes.summary: Per-session todo list keyed by (session_id, position) with content, status, and priority columns, cascading from session and indexed for ordered reads.

nodes.name: session_message
nodes.summary: V2 read-model table populated by projectors-next: one row per SessionEvent-derived message with a type discriminator (assistant/compaction/shell/prompted/...) and JSON data, indexed by session, session+type, and creation time.

nodes.name: permission
nodes.summary: Project-scoped persisted permission ruleset stored as a JSON payload keyed by project_id with cascade delete, backing durable "always allow/deny" decisions.
